module: Catalog of installed interface apps (Vue/JS). getUIAppsData walks /ui/modules/apps/ looking for app.json, app.vue and the app.<directive>.vue variants, and builds a table keyed by app name (translated types, previews, vue/js files, interactive/essential/photomode flags…). The module also watches /settings/ui_apps/ and notifies the interface when a layout changes.
notes: An app.json without domElement or without directive is ignored with an error in the log.
Apps without app.json but with an app.vue (or app.<variant>.vue) are added as "sourceOnly" apps (Embedded category, auxiliary, hidden from the app browser).
The css position keys allowed in app.json are left, right, top, bottom, width, height and margin; the others are removed.
An app whose simplemenu field does not match Engine.UI.isSimpleMenu() is excluded.
A warning is logged if getUIAppsData takes more than 100 ms.

getUIAppsData.desc: Builds and returns the catalog of available apps, keyed by appName.

returns.desc: Data of each app (appName, directive, types, typesTranslated, folder, vueFile, hasAppVue, hasAppJs, interactive, essential, isAuxiliary, photomode, official, previews…).

notifyLayoutsChanged.desc: Sends the UI event 'UiAppLayoutsChanged' so that the interface rereads the layouts.

onFilesChanged.desc: Hook called when files change: if a file is under /settings/ui_apps/, schedules a layout refresh 0.2 s later.

files.desc: List of entries with a filename field.

onUpdate.desc: Frame hook: triggers notifyLayoutsChanged when the delay scheduled by onFilesChanged has elapsed.
